multi_entity_note: Two parties (Martin Operating Partnership L.P. as Owner and Midstream Fuel Service LLC as Charterer).
processing_note: Owner will invoice such fees to Charterer on a monthly basis and Charterer will pay such invoiced amounts within 30 days of invoice date.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading titles it Transportation Services Agreement while the preamble calls it Marine Transportation Agreement; both are self-namings of this agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The preamble states the agreement is executed on the 23rd day of December, 2003.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The term commences on the date first set forth above (the Commencement Date), i.e. 23 December 2003.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term ends on the 3rd anniversary of the Commencement Date; no expiration date is stated as a date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 8 provides the agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement automatically renews for successive one year terms.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Written notice of non-renewal must be given 30 days prior to expiration of the Initial Term or Renewal Term.
